• Protect against data loss: Backups allow you to recover your data in case of accidental deletion, hardware failure, or other disasters.
• Ensure data integrity: Regular backups help maintain the accuracy and consistency of your data across multiple copies.
• Facilitate data recovery: In the event of corruption or damage to one copy of the data, backups can provide a way to recover the data to working condition.
